issue.title: [Enhancement]: Support platform_version on aws_bedrockagentcore_agent_runtime
issue.body:
### Description

The Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime API supports a `platformVersion` (`V1` / `V2`) on `CreateAgentRuntime` and `UpdateAgentRuntime`, and returns it from `GetAgentRuntime`. `V2` ("the new AgentCore Runtime") provides elastic memory and consistent, snapshot-based fast cold starts. The `aws_bedrockagentcore_agent_runtime` resource does not currently expose this field, so Terraform users can't select or change the runtime's platform version. This enhancement adds an optional `platform_version` argument.

### Affected Resource(s) and/or Data Source(s)

* `aws_bedrockagentcore_agent_runtime`

### Potential Terraform Configuration

```hcl
resource "aws_bedrockagentcore_agent_runtime" "example" {
  agent_runtime_name = "example"
  role_arn           = aws_iam_role.example.arn
  platform_version   = "V2"

  agent_runtime_artifact {
    container_configuration {
      container_uri = "123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/example:latest"
    }
  }

  network_configuration {
    network_mode = "PUBLIC"
  }
}
```

### References

* CreateAgentRuntime: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_CreateAgentRuntime.html
* UpdateAgentRuntime: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore-control/latest/APIReference/API_UpdateAgentRuntime.html
* Platform versions (devguide): https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/runtime-how-it-works.html#platform-versions
* The new AgentCore Runtime (what's new): https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/whats-new/2026/09/new-agentcore-runtime-generally-available/

### Would you like to implement a fix?

Yes — implemented in [#50236](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-aws/pull/50236).
